purpose: Provide the shared character animation driver used by player and infected scenes.

animation_selection_v1.configure_clip_selector: configure_clip_selector(selector: Callable) -> void; selector() -> StringName; optional local playback selection, no gameplay state

animation_events_v1.play_one_shot: play_one_shot(state: StringName) -> float; states attack|death|death_forward|death_back|slam|summon (slam/summon need a matching skeletal clip; directional deaths fall back to Death, ADR-0034), returns clip length or 0.0 (death is final)
animation_events_v1.notify_hit: notify_hit(world_point: Vector3 = ZERO, world_direction: Vector3 = ZERO, strength: float = 1.0) -> void; skeletal models twist/rock the torso away from the hit with a damped spring, hips and legs keep the clip (hit_reaction_v1, ADR-0040); no direction rocks back; models without a spine bone flinch as a whole
animation_events_v1.set_active: set_active(active: bool) -> void; pauses animation for distant characters
animation_events_v1.play_dodge: play_dodge(world_direction: Vector3, duration: float, held_weapon := "") -> bool; held_weapon (e.g. AK) keeps that gun drawn through the roll; the body turns along the dodge and the baked dodge_clip (Running_Dive_Roll) plays squeezed into duration; false without that clip or when dead
animation_events_v1.play_named_one_shot: play_named_one_shot(clip: StringName, blend := 0.12, speed := 1.0, leg_clip := "") -> float; plays a clip by name once, emits one_shot_finished(clip), returns its duration; with leg_clip a moving character keeps that locomotion clip on its legs meanwhile (ADR-0045)
animation_events_v1.play_overlay: play_overlay(clip: StringName) -> bool; plays a clip on the upper body only, over the running legs (ADR-0045)
animation_events_v1.attack_legs: an attack/attack_left/attack_right one-shot played while the character moves loops the run or walk clip on the leg bones only (leg_overlay.gd), the attack clip keeps the rest; released when the attack ends or the body stops (held 0.25 s across speed dips, dropped at once on death or set_active(false))
animation_events_v1.play_strike: play_strike(kind: StringName) -> float; melee pose over the playing clips, kind kick (the baked Kick clip, all but the arms, else a procedural rear left leg kick) or punch (procedural left arm); returns its duration, 0.0 without the bones or when dead; is_striking() reports it (ADR-0066)
animation_events_v1.play_turn: play_turn(side: StringName) -> bool; side left|right plays the baked Turn_Left/Turn_Right clip on all bones but the arms (they keep their grip) over the base clip, squeezed to 0.75 s; true while one plays, false without the clip or when dead; is_body_clip_playing() reports it (ADR-0071)
animation_events_v1.play_death_clip: play_death_clip() -> float; plays one random baked Death_* clip once and holds its last pose, returns its length, 0.0 without clips or when dead (ADR-0071)
animation_events_v1.strike_impact_time: strike_impact_time(kind: StringName, fallback: float) -> float; seconds from the start of a strike to its impact, from the Kick clip's impact_time meta, else fallback (ADR-0071)
animation_events_v1.clip_meta: clip_meta(clip, key, default) -> Variant; clip_length(clip) -> float (ADR-0045)
animation_events_v1.prepare_visual: prepare_visual() -> void; idempotent rig/clip preparation; optional defer_setup=true before ready postpones it; set_active requests are preserved

animation_assets_v1.leg_playback_multiplier: @export float = 1.0, finite and clamped 0.5..2.0; scales the playback of a clip_footsteps character's moving locomotion cycles after speed matching, live
animation_assets_v1.clip_footsteps: @export bool = false; emits footstep from the Walk_*/Run_* clip playback phases (clip_footsteps.gd); stance_feet @export bool = true attaches the enemy idle foot turn
animation_assets_v1.cancel_one_shot: cancel_one_shot(clip: StringName) -> void; stops that one-shot early (a cancelled reload) and returns to locomotion
animation_assets_v1.animation_library: @export AnimationLibrary; optional clip set replacing the model's own clips (ADR-0016)
animation_assets_v1.run_exit_ratio: @export float = 0.85; a running character keeps the run clip down to this share of run_speed_threshold (ADR-0040)
animation_assets_v1.enemy_variants: extra_clips named Idle* join the base Idle in a random pool (1-3 cycles each); Transition plays once when an unaware enemy stops after a walk; WalkWander replaces Walk while the character's is_alerted() is false; RunZombie/RunForward are picked once per body; clips with own_pace meta follow their ref_speed (ADR-0071)
animation_assets_v1.extra_clips: @export AnimationLibrary; clips merged into the model's default library; metadata ref_speed (cycle pace, m/s) and strike_time (attack impact, s) are honoured (ADR-0045)
